name: Aishi Tsukushite yo, Sensei
source:
-Yes, she is an insectivore.This is a story about a teacher "I" who is forced into a relationship with a student "she".

[Translated From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8895]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
-是的，她是食虫动物。这是一个关于老师“我”被迫与学生“她”发生关系的故事。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8895]NovelGame[/url]]
